ordered_diagnoses: Opportunistic infection in idiopathic CD4 lymphocytopenia

candidates.name: Histoplasmosis
support_spans: Laryngoscopy revealed thickening of the epiglottic mucosa with irregularity and white plaques
Urine histoplasma antigen: positive at 0.3 ng/mL
Fungal culture grew Histoplasma capsulatum, identified by typical tuberculate microconidia
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory results are consistent with histoplasmosis, a fungal infection that can cause respiratory and laryngeal symptoms.

candidates.name: Idiopathic CD4 lymphocytopenia-associated infection
support_spans: A 54-year-old woman with a medical history significant for idiopathic CD4 lymphocytopenia (ICL)
candidates.why: The patient's underlying condition of idiopathic CD4 lymphocytopenia may predispose her to opportunistic infections, including histoplasmosis.
